messages:
maya: Quick sync — Q3 Hosted API roadmap planning. Focus areas I want us to decide on: chat/completions latency SLOs, embeddings bulk import + async ingestion, dedicated reranker endpoint, and token-pricing experiments. Need prioritization + launch criteria. Agenda: 1) must-have vs nice-to-have 2) customer-driven asks 3) rollout plan. Thoughts?

aj: From eng infra POV: agree on focus. Two quick notes — (a) p95 latency improvements need KV cache + batching work (approx 2 sprints); (b) async embedding ingestion requires a job queue + storage lifecycle. Both doable but we should scope minimal MVP.

lucas: For embeddings customers, the most common ask is bulk upload + status tracking. Proposal: /embeds/bulk -> accepts tar/ndjson, returns job_id; /jobs/:id -> progress + partial results. Also need backfill tool for existing vectors.

elaine: From CS — queue of enterprise asks: 1) large retailer wants embeddings + rerank for product search by EOY, must-have data isolation + delete API, 2) fintech needs deterministic costs (so pricing docs + usage caps), 3) small ML shop wants model-switching knob for A/B. These are deal-breakers for some.

oliver: To help negotiation, I'll propose concrete launch criteria. Draft: ```- Functional: bulk embeddings ingest + job status, basic rerank endpoint, chat completions parity with current hosted API. - Perf: p95 chat latency <= 250ms on standard model for 512-token avg (can relax for 2k tokens). - Reliability: canary rollout and automated fallback to smaller model. - Docs: quickstarts for embeddings and rerank. - Security: delete API + encryption at rest.``` Thoughts?

aj: p95 250ms for 512 tokens is still tight depending on model. If we target a single curated model (opt-13b-quant) perhaps; otherwise we should define per-model profiles. Also recommend we add "cost guardrails" — default batching settings and per-tenant token limits.

lucas: Agree with per-model profiles. Also call out rerank: latency target should be lower priority vs recall — some customers prefer quality over latency. For MVP we can launch rerank as async batch rerank and later add synchronous low-latency reranker.

maya: Good point. Proposal to prioritize: 1) Embeddings bulk ingest + job API + delete API (high customer demand). 2) Chat/completions perf improvements but limit initial SLOs to curated models + clear labeling. 3) Rerank: launch async batch rerank in Q3, synchronous rerank in Q4. 4) Token-pricing experiment as opt-in beta. Agree? :thinking_face:

elaine: +1 from CS. If we commit embeddings + delete API and async rerank, we can close two major enterprise deals. Need SOC/contract language for data handling.

aj: Implementation notes: we'll split into two increments — infra + runtime for caching/batching (sprint A), ingestion + job system + delete API (sprint B). Can deliver embeddings MVP by end of sprint B if no scope creep. I'll add estimates to the spec.

oliver: I'll draft launch criteria doc and a short rollout plan: internal canary (10% traffic), feature flags per-tenant, metrics dashboard (ingest queue length, job success rate, p95 latencies).

maya: Action items: oliver drafts launch criteria + rollout plan by EOD Fri, aj posts engineering estimates in the PRD, lucas writes ingestion API contract (request/response examples), elaine compiles customer ask list for legal. I'll own prioritization and the roadmap deck.

product-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync scheduled Thu 10am calendar invite sent. :bell:

maya: Thanks — let's keep scope tight on the first pass. If anyone hits a blocker, @maya please ping in this thread. :+1:
